entities.description: Custodial investment accounts, linked to a household (38,373 rows in the full extract).

fields.name: AccountId
fields.meaning: Unique internal identifier (GUID) for the account. Primary key.

fields.name: AccountNumber
fields.meaning: Custodian-issued account number. DATA QUALITY ISSUE: a small number of rows contain full account-name text instead of a number (data appears shifted) — sized as NVARCHAR(50) to accommodate until cleaned; a clean version would fit VARCHAR(20). Mapping: Reject rows holding account-name text; clean values fit 20 characters.

fields.name: AccountName
fields.meaning: Display name of the account, typically '<Client Name> - <Account Type>'. Mapping: Source of registration name by parsing '<name> - <type>' (derived at target stage).

fields.name: Balance
fields.meaning: Current dollar balance of the account.

fields.name: CustodianName
fields.meaning: Name of the custodian holding the account (73 distinct custodians in this file). Mapping: Also feeds CUSTODIAN_CODE through the custodian value map.

fields.name: TaxStatus
fields.meaning: Tax treatment of the account (Taxable, TaxDeferred, NonTaxable).

fields.name: RegistrationType
fields.meaning: Legal registration/account type (Rollover IRA, Roth IRA, Trust, etc.). Mapping: About 29% null: exception, never defaulted.

fields.name: DefaultLiquidationMethod
fields.meaning: Default cost-basis method used when liquidating holdings. Only value present is 'FIFO'. Mapping: Single value (FIFO); no target uses it.

fields.name: RepCode
fields.meaning: Custodian-assigned representative/advisor code tied to the account.

fields.name: HouseholdId
fields.meaning: Foreign key to Households.Id. The household this account belongs to. Note: 7 values have no match in Households. Mapping: A few orphan values with no matching household.

fields.name: LastDirectReconDate
fields.meaning: Date the account was last directly reconciled with the custodian feed. Mapping: Operational reconciliation date; no target uses it.

fields.name: ReportedAsOfDate
fields.meaning: Date the account data (balance, etc.) is reported as of.

fields.name: CustodialStartDate
fields.meaning: Date the account was opened at the custodian.

fields.name: ClosedDate
fields.meaning: Date the account was closed, if applicable. Null (73%) = account still open. Mapping: Also drives ACCT_STATUS: Open when empty, else Closed.

fields.name: RiskScore
fields.meaning: Numeric risk score assigned to the account. DATA QUALITY ISSUE: heavily mixed types — a majority of values were mis-stored as Excel dates instead of a plain number, with the remainder split across int/float/string. Staged as NVARCHAR until cleaned, then convert to INT. Mapping: Risk Score is a separate entity (later phase). Mixed types in the source.

fields.name: RiskScoreDate
fields.meaning: Date the RiskScore was last calculated. Mapping: Risk Score entity, later phase.

relationship_rules: Accounts.HouseholdId links to Households.Id; 7 orphan values exist in the full extract.
The source has no account-to-contact (ownership) link. Do not infer owners from name similarity; a documented rule or relationship file is needed.

entities.description: Client households, one per family or entity grouping, linked to an advisor (25,077 rows).

fields.name: AdvisorId
fields.meaning: Foreign key to Users_Advisors.Id. The advisor assigned to this household. Mapping: Resolves the Orion Representative Name through a registered advisor list.

fields.name: Id
fields.meaning: Unique internal identifier (GUID) for the household. Primary key. Mapping: Also the Orion HH Grouping Code.

fields.name: HouseholdName
fields.meaning: Internal/sortable household name, typically 'Last, First' format. Mapping: 'Last, First' sort name.

fields.name: HouseholdProperName
fields.meaning: Formatted display name for the household (e.g. 'Ms. Suzanne Smith'). Mapping: SPARC Household Name.

fields.name: CreatedDate
fields.meaning: Timestamp the household record was created.

fields.name: RiskScore
fields.meaning: Numeric risk score assigned to the household. Mapping: Risk Score entity, later phase.

fields.name: RiskScoreDate
fields.meaning: Date the RiskScore was last calculated. Mapping: Risk Score entity, later phase.

fields.name: RiskToleranceScore
fields.meaning: Score from the household's risk tolerance questionnaire, distinct from RiskScore. Mapping: Risk Score entity, later phase.

fields.name: RiskToleranceScoreDate
fields.meaning: Date the RiskToleranceScore was last calculated/submitted. Mapping: Risk Score entity, later phase.

fields.name: DeletedDate
fields.meaning: Timestamp the household was deleted/archived. Null (78%) = household is still active/live. Mapping: Also drives HH_STATUS: Active when empty, else Deleted.

fields.name: DeletedByUserName
fields.meaning: Email/username of the user who deleted the household, populated only when DeletedDate is set. Mapping: Audit detail of the deletion; information loss to be confirmed with the business owner.

relationship_rules: Households.AdvisorId links to Users_Advisors.Id (advisor list is reference data in this phase).

entities.description: Individual people within each household (15,475 rows). This is the canonical Client.

fields.name: HouseholdId
fields.meaning: Foreign key to Households.Id. The household this contact belongs to. Note: 34 values have no match in Households. Mapping: About 34 orphan values with no matching household.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.meaning: Unique internal identifier (GUID) for this contact/person. Primary key.

fields.name: Salutation
fields.meaning: Formal title (Mr, Mrs, Dr, etc.). Populated for <1% of records. Mapping: No target uses it; under 1% populated.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.meaning: Contact's first name.

fields.name: Nickname
fields.meaning: Preferred/informal name, where different from FirstName. Mapping: No target uses it.

fields.name: MiddleName
fields.meaning: Contact's middle name or initial.

fields.name: LastName
fields.meaning: Contact's last name. Values shown as [REDACTED] — PII masked in this export.

fields.name: Suffix
fields.meaning: Name suffix (Jr., Sr., III, etc.). Empty in every row of this export. Mapping: Empty in every row of the extract.

fields.name: Designations
fields.meaning: Professional designations (CFA, CFP, etc.). Empty in every row of this export. Mapping: Empty in every row of the extract.

fields.name: JobTitle
fields.meaning: Contact's occupation/job title, where on file. Mapping: No target uses it.

fields.name: EmployerName
fields.meaning: Contact's employer, where on file. Mapping: SPARC Employment, only when moving between custodians.

fields.name: EntityType
fields.meaning: Type of contact record. Only value present is 'individual'. Mapping: Only 'individual' occurs; trusts and businesses need a business rule.

fields.name: DateOfBirth
fields.meaning: Contact's date of birth. Values shown as [REDACTED] — PII masked in this export.

fields.name: TaxId
fields.meaning: Contact's tax ID / SSN. Values shown as [REDACTED] — PII masked in this export.

fields.name: HouseholdOrder
fields.meaning: Numeric order/rank of this contact within the household (1 = primary/head, etc.). Mapping: 1 is the primary contact (1st owner), 2 the 2nd owner.

fields.name: HouseholdRelationshipType
fields.meaning: Relationship of this contact to the household (Head, Spouse, Child, etc.). Mapping: 22% null.

fields.name: Address1
fields.meaning: Primary street address line.

fields.name: Address2
fields.meaning: Secondary address line (apt/suite/floor), rarely populated.

fields.name: City
fields.meaning: City of residence.

fields.name: State
fields.meaning: State/province abbreviation. Mapping: SPARC wants full state names.

fields.name: Zip
fields.meaning: Postal/ZIP code. Kept as text to preserve leading zeros. Mapping: Keep as text to preserve leading zeros.

fields.name: Country
fields.meaning: Country code (US, NO, AU, etc.).

fields.name: Phone
fields.meaning: Contact phone number.

fields.name: Email
fields.meaning: Contact email address. Values shown as [REDACTED] — PII masked in this export.

relationship_rules: Household_Contacts.HouseholdId links to Households.Id; 34 orphan values exist in the full extract.
HouseholdOrder 1 is the primary contact; household-level target fields come from that contact.

data_quality: Accounts.AccountNumber: a few rows hold full account-name text (data appears shifted).
Accounts.RiskScore: mixed types; deferred with the Risk Score entity.
Household_Contacts: LastName, DateOfBirth, TaxId and Email are redacted in the dictionary export.

The sample workbook is mostly misaligned: only 89 accounts, 20 households and 20 contacts carry a key; thousands of rows hold only ClosedDate, RiskScore, DeletedDate or RiskToleranceScore values with no id. Confirm the full extract is aligned before trusting counts.
Billing_OffB uses a different key space (11-character ids) from the Amplify GUIDs; join on custodian plus account number.

governance.derived_from: Amplify Data Dictionary and Amplify Data Definitions workbooks
